newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Int. Brachytherapy to debut on Brussels Euro NM.
newsitem.headline: Int. Brachytherapy to debut on Brussels Euro NM.

text.p: The Brussels bourse authorities have given the green light for the bourse listing of Belgian cancer treatment firm International Brachytherapy (IBt) on the EURO.NM, Brussels' new small capitalisation market, a bourse official told Reuters on Thursday.
The listing, which is expected for April, should be the first on the Brussels Euro NM.
"The listing has been cleared. As soon as we get the necessary administrative documents from the company, the listing will follow one or two weeks later," the bourse official said.
Earlier this month the bourse said it was questioning the firm about legal claims against it before it could give the go-ahead for a listing.

IBt said earlier this month that U.S. company Theragenics Corp had lodged a civil complaint with a court in Georgia against IBt and its founders, claiming the latter had appropriated business secrets and confidential information belonging to Theragenics.
IBt's managers are founders and former employees of Nasdaq-listed competitor Theragenics.

The official said that the bourse had not yet received a formal application for listing from the other companies with which it had recently been in contact about a possible listing on its Euro NM market.
"There have been contacts, but no formal applications," the official said.

There have been talks with at least three other candidates, notably British socks and clothing maker Pex Plc, a 38 percent unit of Belgian textile holding company Uniwear; Synergia, a holding company specialised in buying companies in financial trouble; and Ecopolis, a Brussels-based producer of glass recycling boxes.

The Brussels Euro.NM - or New Market - is part of a wider project to form a federation of similar markets in Paris, Amsterdam and Frankfurt, rivalling the recently set up pan-European Brussels-based Easdaq market.
The Paris Nouveau Marche has been running for several months, and Frankfurt's New Market opened earlier this month.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
